lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately 10-12 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher density of smaller spots concentrated anteriorly near the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Light-toned vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to create a distinct grid-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible; a primary mid-lateral carina exhibits a sharp luminance gradient with a bright dorsal edge and a pronounced ventral shadow region.
